qualification: MEASUREMENT OF MACHINE COPPER; verdicts live in the review document
areas_note: stage_A/stage_B are bounding boxes of the donor footprints (refs 2xx / 3xx); other areas come from the layout profile regions
clearance_rule: voltage_domains.clearance_mm per net pair (HARNESS_IGN 2.5 / GDI HV 0.6 / battery 0.3 / default 0.2) minus 0.001 mm, applied to every router item against all copper incl. zone fills; copper at exactly the rule distance passes
coupling_rule: sensitive-net router segment within 1 mm of GDI HV / ignition / battery / switching copper on the same layer
